vars.name: COOKIE_DOMAIN
vars.purpose: API host for the refresh cookie

vars.name: WEB_ORIGINS
vars.purpose: allowed CORS origins (the site on Vercel)

vars.name: API_PUBLIC_URL
vars.purpose: public API base for callbacks and webhooks

vars.name: PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY
vars.purpose: Paystack API auth and webhook signature (HMAC-SHA512)

vars.name: RENDER_CONCURRENCY
vars.purpose: how many videos this server renders at once (a real render needs about 1.5 GB: set 1 on a 4 GB machine)

vars.name: RENDER_WEB_ORIGIN
vars.purpose: R1: the web origin the video renderer opens to play a wish (the render page); the real renderer needs it, none exists yet

vars.name: RENDER_TOKEN_SECRET
vars.purpose: R1: the secret that hashes the one-use token the video renderer reads a wish with (at least 32 characters); the real renderer needs it, none exists yet

vars.name: RENDER_CHROMIUM_PATH
vars.purpose: R1: the browser program the video renderer starts to play a wish; read by the real renderer, none exists yet

vars.name: RENDER_FFMPEG_PATH
vars.purpose: R1: the ffmpeg program the video renderer encodes with; read by the real renderer, none exists yet

vars.name: RENDER_TIME_LIMIT_SECONDS
vars.purpose: R1: the longest one video render may run, in seconds; the job lease is longer than this

vars.name: RENDER_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS
vars.purpose: R1: how long a render token lives, in seconds; read by the real renderer, none exists yet

vars.name: RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET
vars.purpose: signing secret of Resend's webhook stream: delivery news and received mail (YY3)

vars.name: NODE_ENV
vars.purpose: process mode: development, test or production

vars.name: PROVIDERS
vars.purpose: live uses real providers; standin uses in-process stand-ins (refused when NODE_ENV=production)

vars.name: STANDIN_MAIL_OUTBOX
vars.purpose: HK1: a file the stand-in email appends each message to, one JSON line (to, template, subject, text, at); tests only, refused with PROVIDERS=live or NODE_ENV=production

vars.name: STANDIN_CLOCK_OFFSET
vars.purpose: HP6: whole seconds added to the stand-in clock, read once at boot; tests and verifier stacks only, refused with PROVIDERS=live or NODE_ENV=production

vars.name: STANDIN_SCREENING
vars.purpose: API-BASE-12 case 4: rules for the stand-in screening by file name, as a comma list of hold:<part of a name> (the file waits in screening) or reject:<part of a name> (the file is refused); tests and verifier stacks only, refused with PROVIDERS=live or NODE_ENV=production

vars.name: STANDIN_VIDEO
vars.purpose: IK3: `fail` makes the stand-in video renderer fail every job; IK7: `hold` makes it wait until the job's token is read (PROVIDERS=standin binds the stand-in renderer, a small marked file); tests and verifier stacks only, refused with PROVIDERS=live or NODE_ENV=production

vars.name: STANDIN_RENDER_TOKENS
vars.purpose: IK7: a file the stand-in video renderer appends each render's one-use token to (mode 0600); test stacks only, refused with PROVIDERS=live or NODE_ENV=production

vars.name: STANDIN_RENDER_HOLD_FILE
vars.purpose: IK7a: with STANDIN_VIDEO=hold, a render holds only if this file exists when the render starts; test stacks only, refused with PROVIDERS=live or NODE_ENV=production

vars.name: RENDER_STANDIN_HOLD_SECONDS
vars.purpose: IK7: the most seconds the stand-in video renderer waits with STANDIN_VIDEO=hold; test stacks only

vars.name: INTERNAL_TOKEN
vars.purpose: shared secret an internal route needs in the x-internal-token header (32 or more characters)

vars.name: TRUST_PROXY_HOPS
vars.purpose: how many proxies in front of the API are trusted for the client address (V4); 0 reads the socket address

vars.name: PORT_TIMEOUTS_MS
vars.purpose: time limit of one call to a provider port, as port=milliseconds pairs (FF1); payments 10000 unless changed

vars.name: JSON_BODY_LIMIT_BYTES
vars.purpose: the largest JSON body the API reads, in bytes (JJ1); 512 KB, above the 256 KB wish content limit so an oversize wish gets the service's 422
